archives: All 18 publisher archives; first checkpoint exams_part10.zip, fixed earlier by label-blind transport hash; partial results are not the full population and cannot promote.
cohort: All exams in published index with SHA256('20261112|pr6-code15|'+patient_id) first byte < 32, in every archive. This patient-level 1/8 sample is independent of outcomes, preserves repeat examinations, and has no replacements.
signal: Published I II III aVR aVL aVF V1..V6 at 400 Hz. Require centered 48-sample zero border; remove it. If both 648-sample borders are zero, exclude as 7 s or ambiguous. Reject non-finite or flat leads. Per-lead normalization after fixed source preprocessing; no gain inferred for HDF5 if units are undocumented.
reference_limits: Explicit structured publisher 0/1 only. Missing and nonbinary values are excluded endpoint-wise. Benchmark label agreement is not independent clinical adjudication.

evaluation.thresholds: unchanged release thresholds for both systems
evaluation.decisions: independent threshold calls for five endpoints; P8 top-1 fallback is not added to binary calls
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: source patient, paired across model/endpoint with all eligible examinations retained
evaluation.historical_independence: Must report tested overlap separately; independence remains uncertified if source history or patient linkage is incomplete.

candidate.fit: Stage A Chapman and CPSC train only, published feature cache verified, only supervised cells, inverse window multiplicity and equal source weight; validate on Chapman validation only for descriptive fit verification. No holdout or CODE data. No threshold selection.

stage_a_comparison: Stage A was a development pilot (+0.02 F1, <=0.03 sensitivity drop); PR6 is a separately locked transfer gate (+0.03, paired lower CI >0, <=0.05 sensitivity drop, calibration and coverage constraints). No gate is retroactively weakened.
p4: NOT_EVALUABLE_CODE15; require independently sourced endpoint-specific positive and negative reference, not CODE or MIMIC text absence.
